# Every official 6502 instruction in each of its addressing modes, in ca65
# syntax: `#` immediates, `$` hex, and zero page chosen for an address that
# fits in a byte unless `a:` asks for absolute. A branch target is written
# relative to `*`, since a line is assembled at address 0.
	ora ($44,x)
	ora ($FF,X)
	ora $44
	ora $00
	ora $FF
	ora 17
	ora z:$44
	ora $4400
	ora $0100
	ora $FFFF
	ora a:$44
	ora 1000
	ora ($44),y
	ora ($FF),Y

	ora $FF,X
	ora $4400,y
	ora $100,Y
	ora a:$44,y
	ora $4400,x
	ora $100,X
	ora a:$44,x
	ora #$44
	ora #0
	ora #255
	ora #%10101010
	ora #'A'
	ora #<$1234
	ora #>$1234
